title: echites trifidus f. puberulus
intro: Echites trifidus f. puberulus, commonly known as the "Snake Flower" or "Three-leaved Echite", is a plant species native to tropical forests in Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Echites trifidus f. puberulus include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Echites trifidus f. puberulus have been found to include echitamine, echitamidine, and flavonoids such as quercetin and kaempferol.
